name: China Tobacco International (HK) Company Limited
summary: China Tobacco International (HK) Company Limited engages in tobacco business. The company operates through Tobacco Leaf Products Export Business, Tobacco Leaf Products Import Business, Cigarettes Export Business, New Tobacco Products Export Business, and Brazil Operation Business segments. The Tobacco Leaf Products Export Business segment exports tobacco leaf products to cigarette manufacturers and authorized purchasing agents of cigarette manufacturers in Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan.
